result.summary: Several visual and layout issues: truncated restaurant names, duplicate cards in the Fastest section, and cut-off category chips and popular cards.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card title is truncated to 'Smash Bros Bu' instead of the full restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on a second line so the name is fully readable.

issues.description: The first two 'Fastest near you' cards are identical (same image, name 'Green Bowl Poké', delivery time and fee), which looks like a data or rendering bug.
issues.suggestion: Ensure each card shows a unique nearby restaurant; fix any duplicate data binding or carousel logic.

issues.description: The bottom 'Popular right now' pizza card is heavily cropped so only the top of the image and '-20%' badge are visible, with no title or metadata shown.
issues.suggestion: Increase card height, adjust scroll/safe-area padding above the tab bar, or ensure full card content is visible before the bottom nav.

issues.description: Category filter chips are cut off on the right (partial 'Healthy' chip and a trailing fragment), with no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add peek of the next chip, a fade edge, or a scroll indicator so users know more categories are available.

issues.description: Delivery time badges sit over the food images with light backgrounds that can reduce contrast or clutter the illustration.
issues.suggestion: Improve badge contrast and placement (e.g. stronger shadow or consistent corner padding) for clearer readability.
